standard.title: Inverse Dovetail Cutters and Dovetail Cutters with Cylindrical Shanks (Third Revision) (बेलनाकार शैंक युक्त डोवटेल कटर्स और प्रतिलोम (इन्वर्स) डोवटेल कटर्स (तीसरा पुनरीक्षण))
standard.sector: Production and General Engineering / Cutting Tools
standard.description: This Indian Standard specifies the dimensions, tolerances, shank configurations, and general requirements of inverse dovetail cutters and dovetail cutters with plain cylindrical shanks, flatted cylindrical shanks, and threaded shanks. It applies strictly to 45° and 60° dovetail cutters and inverse dovetail cutters with major cutting diameters from 16 mm to 31.5 mm.
standard.scope: This Indian Standard specifies the dimensions, tolerances, shank configurations, and general requirements of inverse dovetail cutters and dovetail cutters with plain cylindrical shanks, flatted cylindrical shanks, and threaded shanks. It applies strictly to 45° and 60° dovetail cutters and inverse dovetail cutters with major cutting diameters from 16 mm to 31.5 mm.

certification.description: Voluntary Product Certification. Every manufacturer of dovetail cutters is highly encouraged to obtain a valid BIS license to stamp or emboss the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' on the packaging, indicating compliance with IS 6255.
requirements: Observed or calculated final test values, thicknesses, angles, and tolerances must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Applies strictly to 45° and 60° dovetail cutters and inverse dovetail cutters.
Specifies major cutter head diameter (d2) held to js16 limits to ensure dimensional accuracy in dovetail groove profiles.
The nominal angles of 45° and 60° are held to a tight tolerance of ±30'.
Shank diameters d1 are held to: h8 for plain cylindrical shanks, h6 for flatted cylindrical shanks, and h8 for threaded shanks.
Standardizes dimensions for 45° cutters: d2=16 (l1=4, l2=60, d1=12); d2=20 (l1=5, l2=63, d1=12); d2=25 (l1=6.3, l2=67, d1=12); d2=31.5 (l1=8, l2=71, d1=16) in millimetres.
